title: More Taiwanese kids physically abuse parents
description: THE number of children physically abusing their parents in Taiwan nearly doubled in the last five years, China Press reported.

title: China-Germany Dialogue: Rescheduling Diplomatic Relations
description: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul and Chinese counterpart Wang Yi discussed security, economic policy, and bilateral issues. They agreed to reschedule Wadephul's trip to China, recently canceled. Both sides emphasized enhancing communication, understanding, and mutual trust, with Wang urging Germany to oppose 'Taiwan independence'.

title: Taiwan Stands Defiant Against China's Diplomatic Aggression
description: Taiwan reaffirms its sovereignty amid China's protests over a meeting between Japan's Prime Minister and Taiwan's APEC envoy. MOFA condemns China's attempts to interfere with APEC interactions, emphasizing Taiwan's rightful participation. Taiwan and Japan pledge continued cooperation, defying Beijing's pressure to isolate Taiwan diplomatically.

title: Diplomatic Dialogues: Taiwan's APEC Engagement Amidst Global Tensions
description: Taiwan's participation in the APEC summit featured significant diplomatic interactions, including a meeting with Japan's Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, sparking protests from China. Despite the absence of formal ties, Taiwan engaged in discussions with various international leaders, pursuing cooperative advancements, particularly with the U.S. in semiconductor development.
